data.title: Emiratisation rate in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Indicator name
metadata.value: Emiratisation rate in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually

metadata.label: Indicator description
metadata.value: This indicator measures the Emiratisation rate in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi  Emiratisation rate: It represents the percentage of UAE nationals (Emiratis) among the total employed workforce in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Emiratisation rate, Emiratisation, UAE nationals, Emirati workforce

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: [Employed UAE nationals resident in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually / Total employed persons resident in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually]  x 100

metadata.label: Last update of indicator information card

aiRecommendation.title: Strengthen Emiratisation Programs to Meet Targets
aiRecommendation.text: Continued growth in Emiratisation rates signals progress, but sustained policy focus is needed to meet sector-specific targets and improve Emirati workforce representation.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: يشير الاستمرار في نمو معدلات التوطين إلى تقدم ملحوظ، غير أن التركيز المستمر على السياسات ضروري لتحقيق الأهداف القطاعية وتعزيز تمثيل القوى العاملة الإماراتية.
aiRecommendation.reason: Emiratisation rates have shown consistent growth from 24.5% in 2021 to 30.5% in 2024, reflecting the success of targeted initiatives. Sustained effort is needed to maintain momentum and meet future national targets.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: أظهرت معدلات التوطين نمواً متسقاً من 24.5% في عام 2021 إلى 30.5% في عام 2024، مما يعكس نجاح المبادرات المستهدفة. ويلزم استمرار الجهود للحفاظ على هذا الزخم وتحقيق الأهداف الوطنية المستقبلية.
